jetSubmissions.title: Regen Level 9 Calibration in Wet Monsoon Conditions
jetSubmissions.symptoms: Aggressive rear wheel slip during throttle roll-off on wet painted road markings when Dynamic Regen is set to Level 9 or 10.
jetSubmissions.operatingConditions: Wet tarmac, ambient temperature 22°C, MRF SteelX tyres at 36 PSI.
jetSubmissions.troubleshootingAttempted: Dialled down Dynamic Regen to Level 4 in Glide mode. Slip eliminated.
jetSubmissions.serviceCentreFindings: Technician verified traction control sensitivity is tuned for linear deceleration; excessive regen on low-friction road paint can cause momentary rear wheel deceleration slip before ABS/TCS modulation.
jetSubmissions.resolutionOutcome: Recommended rider practice: In wet weather, set Dynamic Regen to Level 3 or 4, switch traction control to Rain mode, and avoid harsh off-throttle over road paint.
jetSubmissions.proposedSolution: Add wet-weather regen safety guideline to knowledge base.
jetSubmissions.reviewerNotes: Technically sound and directly matches Ultraviolette owner handbook safety advisory for wet road conditions.

### System Reboot Procedure

This procedure executes a soft reset of the Vehicle Display Unit (VDU) / telematics cluster. 

**Pre-checks:**
* Ensure the motorcycle is stationary.
* Deploy the side stand.
* Ignition must be switched **ON**.

**Execution Steps:**
1. Locate the multi-function navigation switchgear on the handlebar.
2. Simultaneously press and hold the **'O' (Center/Select)** button, the **Left** navigation button, and the **Right** navigation button.
3. Maintain hold until the screen turns black and the instrument cluster initiates the reboot cycle.
4. Release the buttons and allow the operating system to complete its initialization sequence.

---

### Technical Operational Notes:
* **Scope:** This sequence triggers a user-level soft reboot of the display and telematic operating system. It does not discharge the High Voltage (HV) traction battery pack or reset critical BMS fault logs.
* **Persistent Issues:** If the reboot is being performed to resolve an active drive-inhibit fault, HV isolation error, or thermal alert, do not attempt to bypass via repeated resets. Power down the vehicle and contact an authorized Ultraviolette Hangar.

---
**Sources:**
* Ghost Protocol Community Knowledge Base — ID: `RESET BIKE` (Community Validated Resolution)
* Ultraviolette F77 Standard Operating Guide — Switchgear Operations

visitedDestinations.title: Mullayanagiri Peak & Chikmagalur Coffee Trail
visitedDestinations.chargingOptionsOnWay: UV Supernova fast charger at Hassan Highway Plaza (185 km mark) + 15A 3-pin sockets at Café Coffee Day Kunigal & Chikmagalur town homestays.
visitedDestinations.routeSummary: Bengaluru → Kunigal → Hassan (Fast Charge) → Belur → Chikmagalur → Mullayanagiri Peak
visitedDestinations.riderTips: Smooth 4-lane tarmac till Hassan. Switch to Combat mode on the final 18 km ghat climb; heavy regen on the descent recovers ~9% battery SoC.

visitedDestinations.title: Nandi Hills Sunrise & Lepakshi Temple Loop
visitedDestinations.chargingOptionsOnWay: No mid-ride charge required on F77 Recon/Mach 2 (completes on a single charge with ~32% SoC remaining). Devanahalli Supernova station available on return leg if topping up.
visitedDestinations.routeSummary: Hebbal → Devanahalli → Nandi Hills Summit → Bagepalli → Lepakshi → Bengaluru
visitedDestinations.bestTimeToVisit: Year-round • Reach Nandi Foothills before 05:45 AM
visitedDestinations.riderTips: Carry your portable 15A adapter just in case you extend the ride further north. Watch for morning mist on hairpins 4 through 9.

visitedDestinations.title: Madikeri Glass Bridge & Coorg Misty Ghats
visitedDestinations.chargingOptionsOnWay: Maddur Highway Socket Waypoint + Mysuru Ring Road Fast Charger + Community Provided Charger at Kushalnagar Rider Hangar (3.3 kW).
visitedDestinations.routeSummary: Bengaluru → Maddur → Mysuru → Kushalnagar → Madikeri Raja Seat
visitedDestinations.bestTimeToVisit: September to February • Early morning departure
visitedDestinations.riderTips: Top up to 95% at Mysuru before climbing Kushalnagar-Madikeri ghat section. Plenty of scenic coffee stops with 15A sockets.
